gw_inlog.err.not_on: {title} is not installed or is turned off — nothing to restart.
gw_inlog.human.addr: The address the service wants to use does not belong to this server — check the address and the network.
gw_inlog.human.busy: Port {port}/{proto} is already taken by another program — free it or change the protocol’s port.
gw_inlog.human.busy_any: The protocol’s port is already taken by another program — free it or change the port.
gw_inlog.human.cert: The certificate did not fit or was not found — issue it again.
gw_inlog.human.cert_domain: The certificate did not fit. Press “Apply settings”. If that does not help, renew the domain certificate: Settings → Domain and site → “Renew”.
gw_inlog.human.cert_self: The certificate did not fit. Press “Apply settings” — the server writes it again from its settings. It is the same certificate: the devices keep their keys.
gw_inlog.human.closed: Settings were given out more than {minutes} minutes ago and nobody has connected — the port is most likely closed at the hosting provider.
gw_inlog.human.config: The protocol’s settings have an error — reinstall it.
gw_inlog.human.denied: The service lacks permission for a file or a port.
gw_inlog.human.device: The protocol’s network device was not created — the service could not find it.
gw_inlog.human.file: The service is missing a file it needs — reinstall the protocol.
gw_inlog.human.kmod: The kernel module did not load — after a kernel update it has to be installed again.
gw_inlog.human.kmod_awg: The AmneziaWG kernel module did not load — after a kernel update it has to be rebuilt.
